events.title: Actuary and Appointed Actuary
events.summary: 4 months of playtesting and none of our team members have been able to crack Super Actuary in Kamikaze mode. Can you beat them at the game they designed. Agnes and Jawwad are both Fellow Society of Actuaries. They are the world builders and designers of the game the world loves to hate. Achieve Appointed Actuary this weekend. Save your quest review report generated at the end of the game. Email us a copy or drop us a ping or DM with it. We will send over a limited edition, digital copy of the Ar

events.title: We finally found the music in our soul. Next Fest update
events.summary: You asked for music, we have been quitely working behind the scenes to add it. Our latest mid festival build now has a profile specific selection of tracks for your listening pleasure. We will add more as we get to the weekend. There is now a live player feedback ticker tape that evaluates your strategy at run time and give you a heads up. Before you blow up a million dollars. The common feedback over the last 3 days was "point me towards the right direction", "reduce the opacity of the engine",

events.title: New Gameplay Trailer released for October Next Fest.
events.summary: You shared your feedback. We listened. The gameplay interface changed. We added new functionality. Tweaked existing flow.Two months of changes, 20 odd builds updates to Steam. A build every third day. It was time to cut a new gameplay trailer. October Next Fest was just an excuse. We love showing off our game.The new trailer shows the investor finance screen, the revised and updated launch screen and the brand new production pipeline screens. And our new tag line. events.title: New build update. Unlock Steam achievements, track launch and investor impact
events.summary: The 2nd last build before we lock up the demo for Steam October Next Fest. First time player guide is up. New build features now include:1) 20+ new achievements to unlock. Try out Asad, our favorite. Raise 2 million dollars and fail to ship the game. 2) A revised launch center screen that shares the impact of your launch decisions on game sales and revenues. 3) New options and choices in the post launch management center to add more zing to your marketing push.4) A revised and updated capital ra

events.title: The Studio - Indie Grind - Now available for macOS
events.summary: The Studio - Indie Grind is now available for macOS on Apple silicon. We had started with a goal to build games for Windows and macOS. It is a big day for the team that we are finally able to deliver on that promise.Playtest build for macOS will also be available end of day today.

events.title: The Studio Indie Grind - Steam Next Fest Oct 19-26
events.summary: Just heard from Steam earlier in the week that we made the deadline. Catch us at October Next Fest from 19th - 26th October. Add us to your wishlist, join our playtest and help us build a better game. The game hits early access on 2nd November.

Raise capital, hire a team, pick a genre, manage productivity, run launch, clean up post launch mess. All in a days work. How hard could it be? Minimalist, 2D, Economy, Turn based strategy.
